caveats: Adapter diagnostics are seed 0 for three selected methods on 19 existing validation images, not final generative metrics.
Effective rank is the entropy of normalized covariance eigenvalues, not exact rank or proof of absent nonlinear information.
Depth constant estimated using probe_train foreground labels only and evaluated on final test foreground.
Teacher constant estimated from 89 probe_train cached condition tensors, evaluated on 19 probe_val tensors.
audit.description: Post-hoc diagnostics only; no model training or experiment source edits.

verification.scope: CPU plumbing, gradients, fixed rule, annotation boundary, frozen adapter, reduced official flow/decoder, renderer sanity; not GPU pretrained generation parity

conditioning_cache.teacher: TripoSplat native DINOv3 + FLUX.2 image conditioning

interpretation_notes: RL values are final-test results from RL-validation-return-selected encoders; six encoder conditions plus a random-policy control.
Sample SD is computed across RL seeds (ddof=1), not a confidence interval. Random-policy rows repeat one fixed evaluation RNG; their zero SD is not independent-seed evidence.
Transfer averages orbit views within image, then images within RL seed. Native conditioning is shared, so n_seeds=0 and seed SD is null.
Zero-conditioning generations are repeated controls with identical paired settings, not independent evidence for six encoders or three seeds.
Transfer metrics are unregistered orbit diagnostics from an approximate CPU renderer; they do not establish geometric reconstruction quality.

Audit numbers are copied from post-hoc diagnostics. Adapter diagnostics cover only three methods at seed 0 on validation data; teacher/depth constants use training labels or targets, not final-test fitting.

transfer.aggregation: Orbit views averaged per image, images averaged per RL seed, then mean/std across RL seeds. Native is one shared baseline without an RL-seed std.
transfer.renderer: CPU approximation; no exact gsplat parity claim

validation.scope: Report arithmetic, source table agreement, seed/condition/input/view coverage only; no model inference or scientific-validity test.
